cases.task: Fix rules integration; a published API contract explicitly returns a patch.
cases.source:
Contract v3: evaluate returns an object containing changed fields only; omitted means unchanged; null means clear. Number is immutable. originGroup and discount are allowed changes.
Caller currently replaces the full material with {originGroup:'B', discount:0, note:null}, losing Number. Captured response matches the contract. Existing local update_patch implements omission/null correctly.
cases.question: Choose the correction and tests. Avoid blanket bans on merging or inventing a new helper when an existing implementation fits.
